title: Pharaoh statues of past and future outside SAIC headquarters

tellings.quote: And Tom Dong when he was, you know, back in like 2017 doing the rounds, he was like, "Oh, you guys, you know, there's this place outside the SIC headquarters where they've got these two statues

plain: Outside the California headquarters of SAIC, a large US defense contractor, there are said to be two pharaoh statues, one standing for the past and one for the future. Jay Anderson, a researcher of UFO history, says the musician Tom DeLonge, who in 2017 was promoting his UFO research company, told people about the statues back then. It is told as a hint that the contractor sees itself as a keeper of hidden, ancient knowledge.
